facts.raw_span: Gradual hair loss of the eyelashes, eyebrows, beard, and scalp for 4 years
Swelling and painful hand joints for 13 months
Multiple asymptomatic nodules on the upper arms for 40 days
No fever
No previous infections, family history, or personal medical history of autoimmune diseases or psoriasis
Erythrocyte sedimentation rate: 27 mm/h (slightly elevated)
Rheumatoid factor: 70.1 IU/mL (significantly elevated)
Normal results for: C-reactive protein, anticyclic citrullinated peptide, antinuclear antibodies, and globulin levels
X-ray and joint ultrasound showed: osteoarthritis, synovitis, flexor tendon tenosynovitis, and bone erosions
Diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes in the dermis (hematoxylin-eosin stain)
Numerous acid-fast bacilli present (acid-fast stain)
Fundus fluorescein angiography showed uveitis

concepts.why: The presence of non-caseating granulomas, multi-organ involvement, and elevated inflammatory markers support this diagnosis.
The combination of swollen and painful hand joints, significantly elevated rheumatoid factor, and synovitis support this diagnosis.
The presence of diffuse infiltration of the face, loss of skin creases, and diminished facial hair support this diagnosis.
The presence of uveitis, as shown by fundus fluorescein angiography, supports this diagnosis.
The presence of osteoarthritis, as shown by X-ray and joint ultrasound, supports this diagnosis.
The combination of dry eyes, dry mouth, and swollen hand joints support this diagnosis.
The presence of numerous acid-fast bacilli, as shown by acid-fast stain, supports this diagnosis.
The combination of swollen and painful hand joints, psoriatic skin lesions, and synovitis support this diagnosis.

rationales.F01: Hair loss is a common symptom of Sarcoidosis and Lupus Pernio.
rationales.F02: Swollen and painful joints are characteristic of Rheumatoid Arthritis and Psoriatic Arthritis.
rationales.F03: Asymptomatic nodules are often seen in Sarcoidosis and Lupus Pernio.
rationales.F07: Elevated Rheumatoid factor is a strong indicator of Rheumatoid Arthritis.
rationales.F09: Osteoarthritis, synovitis, and bone erosions are common in Rheumatoid Arthritis and Psoriatic Arthritis.
rationales.F10: Diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes is a hallmark of Sarcoidosis and Lupus Pernio.
rationales.F11: Numerous acid-fast bacilli are indicative of Tuberculosis.
rationales.F12: Uveitis is a common symptom of Sarcoidosis and Granulomatous Uveitis.

frontier_selector.rationale: Numerous acid-fast bacilli present, which is a strong indicator of tuberculosis, outweighs other findings
